purpose: Create source-bounded descriptive provider claim candidates from real normalized Moomoo snapshots without interpreting them as financial constraint, reconfiguration, continuity or runtime position evidence.
rules: Only normalized provider snapshots that already project to a W8A provider source candidate may be used.
Every claim must cite the provider sourceId, providerSnapshotId, response digest and explicit observation window.
Claims may report observation count and first/last observed values but may not characterize trend, causality, pressure, constraint, reconfiguration, persistence or continuity.
The last provider observation is not called current unless CWA freshness admission later allows it.
Provider claims remain NOT_EVALUATED_BY_CWA until W8C.
No provider claim may directly change W8E semantic-basis supportState.
